evidence.title: Motion Graphic Design & Animation Principles Website - Zajno Digital Studio

name: Motion
summary: Interactive guide to UI/UX animation principles: easing, offset and delay, fade, morph, masking, scale, parallax, zoom.
description: An interactive site from design studio Zajno that teaches UI/UX animation. It works through easing (linear, ease, ease-in, ease-out, cubic), offset and delay, fade in/out, transform and morph, masking, scale, parallax and zoom, each with live demos, implementation examples and classic-animation references.
contains: walkthrough of techniques: easing, offset and delay, fade in/out, transform/morph, masking, scale, parallax, zoom
classic animation references: slow in and slow out, follow through and overlapping action
sections on what motion does: attention, brand mood, guiding interaction, hinting at controls
